headline: Putin vows 'more painful' response to Ukraine for Crimea bridge attack
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has vowed a more painful response to Ukraine after an attack on the Crimea bridge. The report gives no further details on the response.
why: Escalation in the Russia-Ukraine conflict affects energy supply, sanctions risk and European security spending, which feed into commodity and currency markets.
original_headline: Putin vows ‘more painful’ response to Ukraine for Crimea bridge attack
